*   **Wet COF:** Look for a rating of **0.60 or higher**. This ensures the tile provides enough grip when wet.
*   **Surface Texture:** Glazed tiles can become slippery. Unglazed porcelain or tiles with a matte/textured finish usually have better traction than high-gloss surfaces.

| Feature | Unglazed Porcelain | Glazed Ceramic | High-Gloss Porcelain |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Water Absorption** | < 0.5% (Excellent) | Higher (Variable) | < 0.5% (Excellent) |
